envelope.description: TypeScript parser emits pending EXPORTS rows for re-exports

body.title: TypeScript parser emits pending EXPORTS rows for re-exports
body.summary: In src/indexer/parser/typescript.ts the export_statement branch emits, for `export { a, b as c } from './y.js'`, a pending EXPORTS row per name from the file entity (rawTo = local name, meta { specifier, exportedAs, file, repo }), and for `export * from './y.js'` one row with rawTo '*'. src/db/graph/keys.ts is read-only (EXPORTS keeps byte 7). Anchors: the export_statement branch of the TypeScript parser recurses only into a declaration (src/indexer/parser/typescript.ts:189-196) and emits nothing for a re-export; EXPORTS is byte 7 (src/db/graph/keys.ts:29, read-only). Depends on t3 for pending rows being stored and counted.
acceptanceChecks: The three re-export forms produce the expected pending rows (new src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-reexports.test.ts)
Files without re-exports parse to the same entities and relations as before

tests.name: src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-reexports.test.ts: the three re-export forms produce pending EXPORTS rows; other files unchanged
